categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Silan Microelectronics Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the semiconductor industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of electronic components. Its main product lines include integrated circuits (ICs), discrete devices (such as power semiconductors), and light-emitting diode (LED) products. The company also engages in manufacturing compound semiconductor chips including SiC and GaN power devices, MEMS sensors, and power modules (IPM and PIM).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs an IDM (Integrated Design & Manufacture) model combining chip design and manufacturing. It utilizes multiple wafer sizes (5, 6, 8, 12 inches) for silicon and compound semiconductor production lines. Key technologies include power semiconductor devices like IGBT, MOSFET, SiC MOSFET, GaN devices, MEMS sensor fabrication, and advanced analog and mixed-signal IC design. Manufacturing methods include epitaxial growth, wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing with a focus on automotive-grade and industrial-grade products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Silan Microelectronics serves high-end customers in sectors such as automotive electronics, new energy vehicles, industrial automation, communications, large home appliances (white goods), and high-performance computing. Its products are widely used in electric vehicles, servers, industrial robots, and consumer electronics. The company targets markets requiring high reliability and performance, including automotive and industrial applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with manufacturing and R&D facilities in Hangzhou, Xiamen, Chengdu, Shenzhen, and other cities. It also has subsidiaries and business activities in Hong Kong and overseas investment holdings. The primary sales market is domestic China, with some international exposure through global customers and supply chains.
categories.supply_chain_position: Silan Microelectronics operates as an upstream and midstream IDM semiconductor company, covering the entire value chain from chip design, wafer fabrication, device manufacturing, to packaging and testing. It integrates design and manufacturing capabilities, positioning itself as a comprehensive semiconductor product supplier rather than a fabless or pure foundry model.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes advancing automotive-grade and industrial-grade power semiconductors, including SiC and GaN devices, MEMS sensors, and analog/mixed-signal ICs. It focuses on expanding manufacturing capacity, especially 12-inch wafer lines and compound semiconductor production. R&D efforts emphasize high-performance power modules, energy-efficient power management chips, and sensor technologies aligned with automotive electrification, AI data centers, and new energy markets. The company aims to enhance product quality, cost control, and develop integrated system solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of semiconductor chips, power modules, and LED products. The company sells directly to OEMs and large industrial customers, with income derived from one-time product shipments rather than subscription or licensing models. It also receives government subsidies and investment income, but the core revenue is from hardware sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Silan Microelectronics is a leading domestic IDM semiconductor company in China, ranked eighth among Chinese semiconductor enterprises. It competes with other domestic and international semiconductor manufacturers in power devices, analog ICs, and compound semiconductors. Its IDM model and diversified product portfolio provide competitive advantages in high-barrier markets like automotive and industrial sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved total operating revenue of approximately RMB 11.22 billion, representing a 20.14% increase over 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 219.87 million, a significant turnaround from a loss in the previous year. The company has shown a compound annual growth rate of 29.25% in revenue from 2020 to 2024. Total assets reached nearly RMB 24.8 billion with steady growth in net assets and cash flow from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Silan Microelectronics emphasizes its IDM integrated design and manufacturing capabilities, enabling close synergy between process technology and product development. It offers a broad product portfolio including power semiconductors, MEMS sensors, and compound semiconductor devices with high reliability and performance tailored for automotive, industrial, and high-end consumer applications. The company highlights its quality certifications, long-term customer relationships, and ability to provide one-stop semiconductor solutions that meet stringent industry standards and support domestic chip substitution policies.
